description: Load-mode dispatcher contract (bd-cv653.1.6): list/describe from the snapshot, named errors for unknown tools/actions, and the run/promote interception contract (loud error when a host did not install it).

cases.name: xdev_list_shows_discoverable
cases.description: list names discoverable tools with one-liners

cases.name: xdev_list_omits_essential_tools
cases.description: list never advertises essential-tier tools as discoverable (planted negative)

cases.name: xdev_describe_returns_schema
cases.description: describe returns full description + JSON schema for the target

cases.name: xdev_describe_unknown_tool_named_error
cases.description: describe on an unknown tool names it in the error

cases.name: xdev_unknown_action_named_error
cases.description: unknown action returns a named usage error

cases.name: xdev_run_without_interception_named_error
cases.description: run reaching the tool directly (no agent interception installed) fails loudly with the interception contract

cases.name: xdev_promote_without_interception_named_error
cases.description: promote reaching the tool directly fails loudly with the interception contract
